reason: The primary abstract proposes mutual-information-based estimates of word association norms from corpora, with applications in lexicography and other language-processing tasks. Although one listed application is constraining language models for speech recognition/OCR, the contribution is a corpus-derived lexical statistic, not an LLM inference/serving technique or an inference-efficiency method. Mentioning a language-model application does not make it in scope.
title: Word Association Norms, Mutual Information, and Lexicography
